next.reason: 1985: 'Integer-1 and integer-2 may be signed. Integer-1 must be positive.' 2023 replaces both with arithmetic expressions (§2023:14.9.39.2: arithmetic-expression-1 in format 1, arithmetic-expression-2 in format 2), which may be signed, and states no positivity rule. §2023:14.9.39.4 GR2 and GR4 check the value only at run time, setting EC-RANGE-INDEX when it is 'outside the limit specified in General rule 2 of 13.18.38'. §2023:13.18.38.4 GR2 makes that range include 'occurrence number (1 - integer-2)'. SET idx TO 0 or TO -1, refused at compile time in 1985, compiles and can succeed.
